item.title: Victims of Clerical Sexual Abuse Want More Engagement From Pope Leo
item.description: As he toured South America this month, Pope Leo XIV met with 11 victims of clerical sexual abuse. Some want him to engage more meaningfully.

item.title: U.N. Fails to Regulate Lethal Autonomous Weapons, but Plans to Try Again
item.description: Major military powers like the United States and Russia expressed strong resistance to binding restrictions.

item.title: On the Trail With Spain’s Prime Minister, as He Tries to Pull Out a Win
item.description: Pedro Sánchez, Europe’s most prominent left-wing leader, seems set to lose power in an election next week. Our reporter trailed his last-ditch effort to turn his campaign around.

item.title: In France’s Angry Autumn, TV News Channels Are Accused of Stirring the Pot
item.description: Critics say that CNews and BFM TV, two major news channels, have used racist language in protest coverage. The channels deny it.

item.title: U.N. Climate Talks Collapse in a Bitter Clash Over Fossil Fuels
item.description: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.
